```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(fire)

fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```

```{r}
features <- tibble(features = raw$features)
print(features)

features |> unnest_wider(features)

features |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- features |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "August")) |>
  nrow()

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10)

ggplot(fires, aes(x = gis_acres)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  scale_x_log10()

yearly_acres <- fires |>
  group_by(fire_year) |>
  summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE))

yearly_plot <- ggplot(yearly_acres, aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Acres Burned per Year",
    x = "Fire Year",
    y = "Total Acres Burned",
    caption = "Total reported GIS acres by fire year."
  )

if (nrow(yearly_acres) > 1) {
  yearly_plot <- yearly_plot + geom_line()
}

yearly_plot

fires |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(total_acres)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000)

big_fires <- big_fires |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 1))
    }),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 2))
    })
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires |>
  count(agency) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(agency, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Big Fires by Managing Agency",
    x = "Managing Agency",
    y = "Number of Big Fires"
  )
```

```{r}
largest_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10)

largest_fires <- largest_fires |>
  mutate(
    polygon_lng = map(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 1)
    }),
    polygon_lat = map(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 2)
    }),
    geometry = map2(polygon_lng, polygon_lat, \(longitude, latitude) {
      sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(longitude, latitude)))
    })
  )
largest_fires$geometry <- sf::st_sfc(largest_fires$geometry, crs = 4326)
largest_fires <- sf::st_as_sf(largest_fires)

if (nrow(largest_fires) > 0) {
  map_bounds <- list(
    lng1 = min(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lng)),
    lat1 = min(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lat)),
    lng2 = max(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lng)),
    lat2 = max(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lat))
  )

  leaflet(largest_fires) |>
    addTiles() |>
    addPolygons(
      popup = ~paste0(
        "<strong>", incident, "</strong><br>",
        "Year: ", fire_year, "<br>",
        "Acres: ", format(gis_acres, big.mark = ",")
      )
    ) |>
    fitBounds(
      lng1 = map_bounds$lng1,
      lat1 = map_bounds$lat1,
      lng2 = map_bounds$lng2,
      lat2 = map_bounds$lat2
    )
} else {
  leaflet() |>
    addTiles() |>
    setView(lng = -115, lat = 40, zoom = 4)
}
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- imdb_snapshots |>
  mutate(release_decade = (release_year %/% 10) * 10)

imdb_snapshots |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change, na.rm = TRUE)) |>

```


```{r}
#| cache: true
years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)
addresses <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

scrape_imdb <- function(address, snap_year) {
  page <- tryCatch(
    request(address) |>
      req_timeout(120) |>
      req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
      req_perform() |>
      resp_body_html(),
    error = \(error) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(page)) {
    return(tibble(
      snap_year = integer(),
      rank = integer(),
      title = character(),
      year = integer(),
      rating = numeric(),
      number = numeric()
    ))
  }

  table <- page |>
    html_table() |>
    pluck(1)

  numbers <- page |>
    html_elements("[title*='votes']") |>
    html_attr("title") |>
    str_extract("(?<=based on )[0-9,]+") |>
    parse_number()

  if (length(numbers) != nrow(table)) {
    numbers <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(table))
  }

  tibble(
    rank_title = table[["Rank & Title"]],
    rating = parse_number(as.character(table[["IMDb Rating"]])),
    number = numbers
  ) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      rank_title,
      patterns = c(
        rank = "[0-9]+",
        "\\.\\s+",
        title = ".+",
        "\\s+\\(",
        year = "[0-9]{4}",
        "\\)"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      snap_year = snap_year,
      rank = as.integer(rank),
      year = as.integer(year)
    ) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(addresses, years, scrape_imdb) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015,
    release_decade = (year %/% 10) * 10
  ) |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      average_rank_change > 0 ~ "Rose",
      average_rank_change < 0 ~ "Fell",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = average_rank_change, y = factor(release_decade), fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Rose = "#C44E52", Fell = "#4C78A8", `No change` = "#999999")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "IMDb rank change from the 2015 snapshot to the 2022 snapshot",
    x = "Average Rank Change",
    y = "Release Decade",
    fill = "Rank direction",
    caption = "Sample: 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
